discription: A basic pulse wave synthesizer with an ADSR envelope and adjustable pulse width.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, pulseWidth=0.5, attack=0.01, decay=0.1, sustain=0.8, release=1.0, gate=1;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth) * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);} भूकंप
